name: American Ink Screen Printing, Embroidery & Promotional
old_description: Champion® brand: giving you the confidence to play by your own rules Since 1919.
about:
American Ink Screen Printing, Embroidery & Promotional has operated from Sioux Falls, South Dakota since 1919. The company is an owned-and-operated screen printing, embroidery, and promotional product business serving the greater Midwest region.

The shop provides in-house screen printing and embroidery, specializing in 8-color spot process along with discharge, puff, and glitter inks. It also offers custom design services, web store and fundraiser platforms, and wholesale programs. The company stocks thousands of apparel styles — including t-shirts, jackets, polos, caps, and sweatshirts — from brands such as Bella+Canvas, Carhartt, Under Armour, and Richardson, plus promotional items from Bic, Koozie, and Titleist.

Customers range from businesses and corporate events to charitable organizations, spirit clubs, athletic teams, and schools. Orders are produced to exact specifications, with quantity tiers starting at six pieces and scaling to 200-plus.

American Ink emphasizes turnaround speed and competitive pricing, completing all decoration in-house to maintain quality control. A recent addition is free delivery within a five-mile radius of the Sioux Falls facility.
